hook.text: Milkman's study found that people who could only listen to their favorite audiobook at the gym exercised 51 % more.

buildup.text: Temptation bundling pairs something you need to do with something you want to do. The want makes the need tolerable.

discovery.text: For learning: only listen to your favorite podcast while reviewing flashcards.

twist.text: The bundled temptation must be exclusive to the task. If available anytime, it loses its motivational pull over.

climax.text: Choose one guilty pleasure and make it exclusive to your study time. The anticipation of the pleasure motivates.

punchline.text: My podcast, but only during flashcard review. Bundled motivation.

quiz.question: Why must the temptation be exclusive to the study task?
options: Too many temptations cause decision fatigue
If the temptation is available anytime, it loses its motivational pull
Exclusive items are more expensive and feel more rewarding
